# The engine's `idempotency-docs-v1` route set (U-92a, engine PR #178): the
# document draft claim and convert, each `x-idempotency: true` in its
# openapi.json, recorded from engine main 38cf97eb (the pin since A03).
# Append-only for this capability name. A03 covers both: each is
# `keyable-docs` in operations.txt (`KeySet::DocsV1`), keyed only while the
# engine advertises `idempotency-docs-v1`.
